open_items.summary: The automation Worker has no LLM provider key, so a scheduled seo_draft_generation job fails closed with the non-retryable llm_provider_missing and writes no draft. Owner-triggered generation through Pages is unaffected, because Pages holds the provider secrets. Setting one of MISTRAL_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, CEREBRAS_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY as a secret on the gptbot-automation Worker completes unattended scheduled generation. Cloudflare secrets cannot be read back, so the value has to come from the owner.

Cloudflare Pages production carries a secret_text variable literally named ___ , almost certainly a residue of the earlier empty-named KV binding incident. It is read by no code. Left in place because R0.4 authorised removing only the TEST_MERGE_PROBE preview artifact, and deleting an unread secret is not reversible.

The owner-kit item workflow_disabled requires provider-ui evidence from the n8n interface and stays false. It does not affect GPTBot: the route is 410 and the bearer is unbound. See N8N_RETIREMENT_DEVIATION.md.
